starting-off.speaker: Gary
starting-off.text: Hello. I wonder, could you help me with a project I'm doing?

options.text: Who are you, and what is this about?

steps.player: Who are you, and what is this about?

steps.text: First time:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I'm Gary Grayzag, a wizard. At least, I'm going to be a wizard. My dad's one too - Wizard Grayzag, from the Wizards' Tower south of Draynor Village.

steps.text: So, yes, I was saying that Wizard Grayzag is my dad.

steps.player: I remember that name. I was asked to find a load of beads that Grayzag's imps stole.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: That's my dad, yes! I'm sorry about his... manners.

steps.player: So what do you need from me?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I'm trying to recreate a portal that my dad accidentally opened, some time ago.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: My dad was trying to invent a time travel portal, so he could go into the past and meet mighty demons of the Third Age like Thammaron, and maybe control them.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Instead, the portal led to the history of RuneScape, rather than the history of Gielinor. In the Realm of Memories, he says there are demons and dragons as they looked in older times.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Other creatures too, as they used to be, and people who've departed long ago, like Thrander, the smith who performed armour conversion services.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: So now I'd like to recreate a portal like what my dad saw, so that I can enter the Realm of Memories for myself, and prove I should be a fully qualified wizard rather than an apprentice!

options.text: Yes, I'll help make a portal to the Realm of Memories!

steps.player: Yes, I'll help make a portal to the Realm of Memories!

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Thank you so much! To open the portal to the Realm of Memories, I believe we need mementos that will invoke powerful memories of the world.

options.text: Tell me about the mementos that we need.

steps.player: Tell me about the mementos that we need.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: The mementos must be artefacts that invoke powerful memories. And, in RuneScape, what could be more powerful than the memory of experience?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: The experience people have gained, every single day, since the world was created, training their skills - imagine how intense that collective memory will be! So my ritual uses mementos of the 24 skills.

options.text: Okay, let's get on with it.

steps.player: Okay, let's get on with it.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I've worked out where we can get suitable mementos around Varrock, and I've prepared a place upstairs in this building where we'll perform a ritual with them.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Whenever you're ready, we'll go around Varrock together to collect the mementos.

options.text: Let's go.
I need to go and do something else.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: That'd be convenient! But no, I need to obtain the items with you myself. Otherwise the memories associated with them aren't transferred to me.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I saw a thief roaming the south-east end of the city, just east of where we met. I'm sure he'll have a memento of Thieving - but we shouldn't ask where he got it!

options.text: Yes please!
Can you tell me about your cape?
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
No thank you.
Can you help Gary collect a skill memento, please?

steps.player: Can you help Gary collect a skill memento, please?

steps.text: If Gary isn't with the player:

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.text: I don't know any Gary. Go away.

steps.player: He must be nearby. I'll go and fetch him.

steps.text: If Gary is with the player:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Well, I understand you're a thief...

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.text: You making assumptions about me? How's a chap supposed to make an honest living if everyone just calls him a thief before he's even done anything?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Look, I just need a little memento from you. I won't ask where you got it from, and I promise I'll never call you a thief again.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.text: Sounds like blackmail! Now who's the thief? But alright, take this and get out of here...
Gary transports the new memento to his ritual grid...

steps.player: Where do we need to go?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Old Man Yarlo is a retired builder. He'll be able to help us with a memento of Construction. He lives slightly north-east from where you & I met.

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.text: I mind my own business. That way I don't get cut.

options.text: Actually, I'll leave you alone.

steps.player: Actually, I'll leave you alone.

collecting-mementos-visiting-old-man-yar.text: If the player has not completed Daddy's Home:

steps.speaker: Old Man Yarlo
steps.text: What brings you here, young [lady/man/one]?

collecting-mementos-visiting-old-man-yar.text: If the player has completed Daddy's Home:

steps.speaker: Old Man Yarlo
steps.text: Hello again, young [lady/man/one]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.

options.text: Can you help Gary with a skill memento, please?

steps.player: Can you help Gary with a skill memento, please?

steps.text: If Gary isn't with the player:

steps.speaker: Old Man Yarlo
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.player: Oh, I didn't bring Gary. At least he's probably not far away.

steps.text: If Gary is with the player:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: As a famously experienced builder, perhaps you could help me, please. I need a memento of Construction, something to invoke the memories of training the skill. Perhaps a saw.

steps.speaker: Old Man Yarlo
steps.text: Eh? That's a strange request, young man. But you've asked nicely, and I do like to encourage young folks when I can, even if I don't understand why.
Gary transports the new memento to his ritual grid...

steps.player: Where do we need to go?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: The Apothecary would be well placed to get us a memento for Herblore. His shop's in the south-west of the city.

options.text: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.

collecting-mementos-at-the-apothecary.speaker: Apothecary
collecting-mementos-at-the-apothecary.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

options.text: Can you make potions for me?
Can you help Gary get a skill memento, please?

steps.player: Can you help Gary get a skill memento, please?

steps.text: If Gary isn't with the player:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: What kind of thing does Gary want?

steps.player: I should fetch him, so he can tell you!

steps.text: If Gary is with the player:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: You are widely renowned as an expert on Herblore! Would you perhaps be able to give me a potion, as a memento of that noble skill, please?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: A potion? Oh yes, I make lots of those. Here's one I made for my mother - you can have it, since she didn't drink it all...
Gary transports the new memento to his ritual grid...

steps.player: Where do we need to go?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Just outside the city, to the south-west, Dreven the bush patch gardener should be able to help us with a Farming memento.

options.text: Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.
Talk about something else.
Would you look after my crops for me?
Can you help Gary get a skill memento?

steps.player: Can you help Gary get a skill memento?

steps.text: If Gary isn't with the player:

steps.speaker: Dreven
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.player: I'll fetch him, so he can explain.

steps.text: If Gary is with the player:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I need a memento of Farming, something that evokes the memory of all the training you'll have done.

steps.speaker: Dreven
steps.text: Um... memory of training Farming? I suppose we usually start out by raking a patch, so I'll give you a rake.
Gary transports the new memento to his ritual grid...

steps.player: Where do we need to go?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Tarquin will have something helpful for us, I'm sure. He's by the riverbank, supervising the canoe station south-west of the city.

options.text: Can you sell me something?
I'll come back another time.

collecting-mementos-at-the-canoe-station.speaker: Tarquin
collecting-mementos-at-the-canoe-station.text: Hello old bean. Is there something I can help you with?

options.text: Can you help Gary get a skill memento, please?

steps.player: Can you help Gary get a skill memento, please?

steps.text: If Gary isn't with the player:

steps.speaker: Tarquin
steps.text: I don't quite follow you, old bean!

steps.player: Gary can explain. I'll go back and fetch him.

steps.text: If Gary is with the player:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I understand you are an expert on watercraft. Do you have a memento of Sailing, or anything like that? I know your canoes don't have sails, but we're miles from the sea!

steps.speaker: Tarquin
steps.text: Hah! Canoes really are not the same thing at all. Fortunately for you, as a close relative of Misthalin's royal family, I have had ample opportunity to experience the joys of a royal yacht.

steps.speaker: Tarquin
steps.text: So I do know about Sailing. It's tremendous fun, though canoes will always remain my first passion. And yes, I do have a memento of my time at sea.
Gary transports the new memento to his ritual grid...

steps.player: Where do we need to go?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Dr Harlow has experience of specialist combat supplies, and also of Woodcutting, I think. He's in the Blue Moon Inn, just north of where you & I met.

options.text: Who are you?
Could you teach me about canoes?
No thanks, not right now.
Can you help Gary collect mementos of some skills, please?

steps.player: Can you help Gary collect mementos of some skills, please?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Wha...?
If Gary isn't with the player:

steps.player: Oh, never mind, I'll go back and fetch him.

steps.text: If Gary is with the player:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I believe you are a specialist in slaying certain monsters, are you not?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Speshialist? Proper speshial, yeh, that's me.
If the player has not completed Vampyre Slayer:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Can I have one of the special tools you use for slaying vampyres, please? Although unconventional, I think it will work as a memento of the specialist combat techniques involved in Slayer!
If the player has completed Vampyre Slayer:

steps.player: Vampyre slaying, right?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Ohhh. Yeh. I met you before. You got me beer! Very kind.

steps.player: So can you give Gary what he needs now, please?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I need one of your stakes, please. Although unconventional, I think it will work as a memento of the specialist combat techniques involved in Slayer!

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: If you also give me some of the wood from which you make them, that would constitute a memento of Woodcutting too.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Eh... whatever, you take it.
Gary transports the new mementos to his ritual grid...

steps.player: Where do we need to go?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I think we have a memento for every skill! Let's return to the building where we met, and see how the ritual grid is looking! It's upstairs.

options.text: I think you've had enough.

collecting-mementos-straying-too-far-out.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-straying-too-far-out.text: I think we're getting a bit off course.

options.text: Alright, let's go back.

steps.player: Alright, let's go back.

options.text: I've got other things to do now. Can you leave?

steps.player: I've got other things to do now. Can you leave?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I'll wait back at the house in southern Varrock. We can meet there when you're ready to continue.

collecting-mementos-using-any-item-on-ga.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-using-any-item-on-ga.text: Thank you, but your own items will be of no use to me.

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house.text: Excellent, all the skills are represented now. I can feel the power building up already!

options.text: So do I get my rewards now?

steps.player: So do I get my rewards now?

steps.text: If the player has completed Imp Catcher:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Ah, the archetypal adventurer, always seeking quest rewards - no wonder Mizgog roped you into finding beads for him! Don't worry, we'll get there soon.
If the player has not completed Imp Catcher:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Ah, the archetypal adventurer, always seeking quest rewards! Don't worry, we'll get there soon.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Just one more thing is needed. For the centrepiece of the grid, we need something to represent RuneScape itself. An item that has always had a uniquely iconic status since the world's earliest days:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: A cabbage!

options.text: That's nice.

steps.player: That's nice.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Just one more thing is needed. For the centrepiece of the grid, we need something to represent RuneScape itself. An item that has always had a uniquely iconic status since the world's earliest days:

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: A cabbage!
If the player does not already have a cabbage:

steps.player: I suppose I'd better go find one.

steps.text: If the player already has a cabbage:

steps.player: I am indeed carrying a cabbage.

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-us.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-us.text: That's not really what I need.

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.text: Do you have a cabbage for me?

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.player: I am indeed carrying a cabbage.

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.text: Wonderful! In that case I think the ritual can begin...
Gary places your cabbage in the ritual grid.
The ritual uses full screen flashing effects that may affect some players.

options.text: Disable effects

steps.text: You have disabled the effects. You can visit the 'Settings' menu at any time to re-enable them.

options.text: Leave effects enabled

steps.text: The ritual will proceed with full screen flashing effects enabled.

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.text: A cutscene plays of Gary opening the portal to the Realm of Memories.

collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.speaker: Gary
collecting-mementos-back-at-the-house-re.text: I DID IT! I opened the portal! You can go on through - I'm going to call my dad and tell him!

finishing-up.text: You hear Gary following you through the portal... ... and someone else too.

finishing-up.speaker: Gary
finishing-up.text: Oh, [player name], it's everything I ever hoped for! The demons, the dragons, the orcs - all looking like they did in the old days! And my dad's even come too!

finishing-up.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
finishing-up.text: Yeah, you did good, kid. I won't pretend I'm into this kind of thing, but you did a proper good job on the magic ritual.

finishing-up.speaker: Gary
finishing-up.text: Thanks, dad! So, now I've proven myself, can I ditch the 'apprentice' title, please? This feat surely qualifies me for higher status, right? Pleeeeease?

finishing-up.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
finishing-up.text: Eh... go on then. Don't forget to reward [player name] too - you know how adventurers moan when they don't feel properly rewarded! Now I'm going home.

finishing-up.speaker: Wizard Gary
finishing-up.text: This has been such a great day! I'm in the Realm of Memories, and I've even finished my apprenticeship. [player name], thank you so much!

finishing-up.speaker: Wizard Gary
finishing-up.text: Now, I must reward you for your time and trouble. I hope you've got some inventory space...
You've completed the Birthday event: 25 Years, 25 Mememtos
If the player does not have enough inventory space for the rewards:

steps.text: You need [number] more free inventory slots to receive your Birthday event rewards.

in-the-realm-of-memories-wizard-gary.speaker: Wizard Gary
in-the-realm-of-memories-wizard-gary.text: I'm having a wonderful time exploring the Realm. I hope you are too.

options.text: Remind me, what actually is this Realm of Memories we're in?

steps.player: Remind me, what actually is this Realm of Memories we're in?

steps.speaker: Wizard Gary
steps.text: My dad was trying to invent a time travel portal, so he could go into the past and meet mighty demons of the Third Age like Thammaron, and maybe control them.

steps.speaker: Wizard Gary
steps.text: Instead, the portal led to the history of RuneScape, rather than the history of Gielinor. That's why we can see demons and dragons as they looked in older times.

steps.speaker: Wizard Gary
steps.text: Other creatures too, as they used to be, and people who've departed long ago. And now I've managed to open my own portal, so I can see it all too, thanks to you!

options.text: Yes, thanks.

steps.player: Yes, thanks.

in-the-realm-of-memories-gnome-child.text: If the player did not complete the 20th Anniversary event:

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: Welcome to the Realm of Memories.

in-the-realm-of-memories-gnome-child.text: If the player completed the 20th Anniversary event:

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: I am so glad you have returned to the Realm of Memories, all these years after our adventure together!

options.text: Why are all the gnomes here green?

steps.player: Why are all the gnomes here green?

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: In my day all gnomes were green, like our trees. Although the world has changed, and gnomes are no longer green, the Short Green Guy cocktail is so named because of this.

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: In fact, Blurberry still instructs his apprentices not to bring him a gnome when he asks for a Short Green Guy!

options.text: So what do you actually do here?

steps.player: So what do you actually do here?

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: The people you see here all dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.

options.text: Thank you.

steps.player: Thank you.

post-event-talking-to-wizard-grayzag.text: If the player has completed Imp Catcher:

steps.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
steps.text: So you think finding those beads makes you clever, do you?

steps.player: Well yes, actually.

steps.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
steps.text: Well you'd better just watch your back, because when you least expect it I'll be there. You shouldn't go sticking your nose into other people's affairs, meddler.

post-event-talking-to-wizard-grayzag.text: If the player has started Imp Catcher:

steps.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
steps.text: You're a fool, [player name]. Do you really think you'll find four imps out of thousands? Good luck. Ha!

post-event-talking-to-wizard-grayzag.text: If the player has not started Imp Catcher:

steps.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
steps.text: Not now, I'm trying to concentrate on a very difficult spell!

post-event-talking-to-wizard-grayzag.text: If the player has started or completed the 20th Anniversary event:

steps.player: You were nicer to me when you had that little gnome wandering around here before.

steps.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
steps.text: Well he's not bothering me anymore, is he? And you don't need to bother me either!

post-event-talking-to-wizard-grayzag.text: If the player has completed the 25th Anniversary event:

steps.player: You seemed like a completely different person when you were complimenting Gary on his ritual that opened the Realm of Memories.

steps.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
steps.text: My son's a smart kid who's becoming a great wizard, while you're a do-gooder who fetches & carries stuff for smarter people. I know which of you two earned my respect.

post-event-talking-to-wizard-grayzag.text: If the player has not done either event:

post-event-using-an-item-on-one-of-the-m.text: You feel you should leave it alone.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I'm Gary Grayzag, the wizard. Well, apprentice wizard. My father is Wizard Grayzag. He once accidentally created a portal to the Realm of Memories.

steps.text: I'm Gary Grayzag, the wizard. Well, apprentice wizard. My father is Wizard Grayzag. He asked you to deal with the green Gnome Child that came through a portal from the Realm of Memories.

steps.player: Oh yes, and his imps stole all those beads from Wizard Mizgog.

steps.speaker: Gary

jump-86f1b8fab6b2c8a3.speaker: Gary
jump-86f1b8fab6b2c8a3.text: Thank you so much! To open the portal to the Realm of Memories, I believe we need mementos that will invoke powerful memories of the world.

options.text: Tell me about the mementos that we need.

steps.player: Tell me about the mementos that we need.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: The mementos must be artefacts that invoke powerful memories. And, in RuneScape, what could be more powerful than the memory of experience?

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: The experience people have gained, every single day, since the world was created, training their skills - imagine how intense that collective memory will be! So my ritual uses mementos of the 24 skills.

options.text: Okay, let's get on with it.

steps.player: Okay, let's get on with it.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: I've worked out where we can get suitable mementos around Varrock, and I've prepared a place upstairs in this building where we'll perform a ritual with them.

steps.speaker: Gary
steps.text: Whenever you're ready, we'll go around Varrock together to collect the mementos.

options.text: Let's go.
